name: from_ptr
declaration: const unsafe fn from_ptr < 'a > (ptr : * mut bool) -> & 'a AtomicBool
rules: `ptr` must be aligned to `align_of::<AtomicBool>()`; this alignment requirement is always satisfied because `align_of::<AtomicBool>() == 1`.
`ptr` must be valid for both reads and writes for the whole lifetime `'a` of the returned `&'a AtomicBool`.

Accesses to the memory at `ptr` must not create a data race: overlapping accesses, at least one of which is a write and at least one of which is non-atomic, must be synchronized so that one happens-before the other. An unsuccessful `compare_exchange` or `compare_exchange_weak` is not considered a write.

Every pair of non-synchronized atomic accesses involving the memory at `ptr` must either access disjoint regions, access exactly the same region with the same access size, or both be reads. Accesses are non-synchronized when neither happens-before the other.
Concurrent atomic and non-atomic reads of the same memory at `ptr` are permitted.
